title: Case Study: Maximizing Revenue with 4 Units of Dawnice 100kW/200kWh All-In-One ESS in Israel (May 2026)
summary: Four 100kW/200kWh all-in-one units combined into a 400kW/800kWh microgrid for a factory in Israel.
challenge: Israel's commercial sector works with wide peak-to-valley tariff gaps and heavy grid strain at peak, so both the factory supply and the tariff spread matter.
solution: Four all-in-one cabinets, 400kW / 800kWh in total, split under a "1+3" arrangement so one unit covers factory supply while three work the tariff spread.
result: The split lets part of the fleet trade while the rest keeps the factory running; the site uses high-density 280Ah LiFePO4 cells in a 1P224S layout.
